topic: Which cloud and local coding models are worth offering in Moonzila as of 2026-10-05: current API model ids with context and output limits, tool-calling reliability, how vendors use and retain API inputs, and for small local models their licences, Ollama availability and sizes, runtime version and CPU requirements
notes: Run 1 of 2, the cloud side: 15 owner pages named directly plus 1 search keeping 1 page = 16 pages (maxScrapes 16), about 18 credits. Run 2 is research/plan-2.json (local side, 15 pages, about 17 credits) - about 35 planned. research/plan-conditional.json holds pages run only when a named trigger fires (8 pages, about 10 credits), and research/DISCOVERY.md under Capture risks allows up to 10 more pages whose URLs can only be copied from a capture these runs make. Worst case if every trigger fired: about 55 credits, over the project's 45 cap; the order in which conditional pages are collected, and which give way at 45, is in research/DISCOVERY.md under Capture risks (review round 2, fix 3). No plan-level prefer (review round 1, fix 3): research-run.mjs merges it into every query's own list, so each query names only its own owner hosts. Where each URL comes from (grep of every raw capture under docs/, 2026-10-05; the full table is in research/DISCOVERY.md under Collection plan): linked from an existing capture - the Claude models overview, the gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.7-flash model pages, the Mistral Medium 3.5 card, the Gemini API terms, the OpenAI your-data guide; linked from no capture - the two OpenAI model pages (only the family pattern is linked; fallback: the model catalog in plan-conditional.json), the BFCL leaderboard, Anthropic's commercial terms, both DeepSeek policy pages, legal.mistral.ai terms-of-service, the OpenRouter models endpoint and the LiveBench model_judgment dataset card. Risks, each resolved in research/DISCOVERY.md under Capture risks: a pattern-only URL may 404 (one credit, not refetched within 30 days); the BFCL table is loaded by script (a placeholder capture is the U-05 finding, no mirror is searched for); the OpenRouter JSON may be graded partial; the U-09 search may keep no Anthropic page. Not collected again, by decision: prices, coding ranks, Gemini rate limits and the DeepSeek models (docs/research/2026-10-02-model-pricing-and-ranking: its E-01..E-06, E-09, and its DeepSeek capture lines 24-46).

queries.q: Anthropic API how long are inputs and outputs retained commercial customers data retention
queries.why: U-09: Anthropic's own page on how long commercial API inputs and outputs are kept (the commercial terms say whether they train, not how long they keep). A kept page is type S, promoted to P only if it is on an Anthropic host (privacy.claude.com, support.claude.com, platform.claude.com, or anthropic.com and its subdomains); if the search keeps no Anthropic page, U-09 claims no retention period unless the commercial-terms capture states one, and the retention half is KNOWN-UNKNOWN with the day-one step in research/DISCOVERY.md
